exclusions.reason: Association mission, contact/register identifiers and thanks are incidental provenance. Mobility value and reform goals are normative. Regional supply imbalance is a conditional possibility, not a measured national distribution.

Predicted flexibility, varied experts, approval, greater practice, future savings and lower accident risk are explicitly opportunities/forecasts. No observed savings or universal pedagogical equivalence is inferred; their present legal and cost premises are inventoried.

Up-to-one-third future saving, predicted initial German uptake and nationwide introduction/evaluation recommendations are forecasts or policy preferences; Austrian empirical premise is retained separately. Contact block is incidental.
Introductory institutional history, nearly-three-decades framing, thanks, quality priorities and reform openness are incidental or normative; no material quantitative historical estimate is used.

Desired school binding, six 90-minute presence units, proposed topic list and digital competence documentation are recommendations. Forecasted authority staffing/cost changes and avoided repeats are not observed outcomes. Presence’s asserted special pedagogical role is framed as the association’s judgment, without a specific comparative experimental result.

Predicted selection pressure, commercial portal ranking effects and rural closures/access costs are conditional policy risks, not observed consequences. The cost-accounting and raw-rate premises are separately retained.

Evaluation, competence safeguards, timing recommendations and constructive participation are normative. The final Finland text expressly rejects interpreting targeted amendments as a blanket reform reversal; no contrary claim is invented.

limits: Conservative independent initial check, not a human specialist review or author contact.
All eight assigned physical pages read; no counterpart inventory or prior issue disposition used for extraction.
Unresolved access, denominator and causal questions are not error findings. Pure forecasts and preferences are page-based exclusions.
